_README: Source of truth for the rental-owner (landlord) contact blocks, the owner-page scope section and the
owner signposts. scripts/build_owner_path_blocks.py renders them into the pages listed under 'pages',
Edit this file and re-run the script; do not hand-edit between the markers.
PHONE: the block reads data/business-contact.json (phone_display, phone_tel). That file is the single
place to change the number. Nothing here carries a phone number.
TEXT BUTTON: shown only when the number in business-contact.json phone_tel is listed in sms_lines;
otherwise the block offers call and email only.
OWNER SERVICES: owner_services renders as a list on the owner page. Each entry is an object with one
key, copy (the visible text); any other key stops the script. An empty list renders nothing.
evidenced_scope: Gadura Real Estate, LLC is a licensed New York real estate brokerage. Nitin Gadura is a Licensed Real Estate Salesperson supervised by the firm's broker.

New York requires a broker to give a landlord the agency disclosure form before a listing agreement is signed (Real Property Law §443), and the State's Housing and Anti-Discrimination Disclosure at the first substantive contact (19 NYCRR 175.28).
Commissions are negotiable and are not set by law.
